Quaternionic Weinberg-Salam Theory

Katsusada MORITA

Department of Physics, Faculty of Science
Nagoya University, Nagoya 464

(Received September 12, 1981; revised December 21, 1981)

A quaternionic Weinberg-Salam theory is formulated based on the assumption that fer-
mions and Higgs mesons are defined over quaternions. The new formalism, reproducing the
left-right symmetric SU(2). X SU(2)xe X U(1) Weinberg-Salam theory at the phenomenological
level, offers an algebraic explanation for replication of quarks and leptons in flavor

blocks.title: Page 2
blocks.content:
Quaternionic Weinberg-Salam Theory 1861

tion of quarks and leptons in flavor doublets: We assume that quarks and
leptons are regarded as objects over quaternions. The Weinberg-Salam theory is
then reformulated as an algebraic gauge theory over quaternions.” (Quaternionic
description of isospin doublets was once tried® but soon abandoned perhaps
because isospin symmetry is broken explicitly and there exist higher dimensional
isospin multiplets. On the other hand, flavor symmetry is broken spontaneously
and there seem to exist only flavor doublets in generation. )

The quaternionic gauge theory

The next-section is a detailed exposition of Ref. 7) where we have reported
preliminary results. We shall discuss some ingredients of the quaternionic
Weinberg-Salam theory in § 3. Section 4 presents a Hilbert-space formulation by
constructing a Fock space for gauge singlets using complex scalar products.’”
The last section is devoted to a summary and discussions. We shall discuss the
quaternionic variational principle and the spontaneous symmetry breakdown of
the quaternionic symmetry in the Appendix.
